title: woh husain mera hai
body:
woh husain mera hai..
zeest jiski baandhi hai, woh husain mera hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Maut jispa marti hai, woh husain mera hai
jiski sab khudai hai, woh husain mera hai
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Kibriya bhi uska hai, ambiya bhi uske hai
awsiya bhi uske hai, awliya bhi uske hai
<<DIVIDER>>
khalq saari jiski hai, woh husain mera hai
2. Aisa kiski naami hai, aisa kiska naama hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ka sadqa kauna maka, ek arab ki malka hai
jo waqar e hasti hai, woh husain mera hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Daadi jiski binte asad, aur jadd abu talib
maa hai fatima zahra, baap ka laqab ghalib
<<DIVIDER>>
jo wurude nasli hai, woh husain mera hai
4. Jiske darr par aae malak apni jholiya phailaye
<<DIVIDER>>
jiske darr se fitrus bhi aake baalo par lejaye
rizwa jiska darzi hai, woh husain mera hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Jiske daste qudrat me baagh hai nabuwat ki
deen ka to kehna kya jab ke khud mashiyat bhi
<<DIVIDER>>
kalma jiska padhti hai, woh husain mera hai
6. Jiske waaste naaqa bangaye ho khud sarwar
<<DIVIDER>>
tool de de sajde ko hukme rab se paighambar
jo khuda ki marzi hai, woh husain mera hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Saat(7) bete rahib ko bakhshe apne tiflee me
ek habib hi ko kya deen ko zaeefi me
<<DIVIDER>>
jisne zindagi di hai, woh husain mera hai
8. Fikr ummate jadd ki jisko thi tahe khanjar
<<DIVIDER>>
ki tilawate qura'a jisne nauke naiza par
deen jisse baqi hai, woh husain mera hai
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Kuch nahi yaha tafreeq rang o nasl o mazhab ki
ek sabka maslak hai ek qaumiyat sabki
<<DIVIDER>>
bazm ye husaini hai, woh husain mera hai
11. Haath katgaye fir bhi behro bar pa qabza hai
<<DIVIDER>>
qabza karke darya par aaj bhi to pyaasa hai
jiska aisa bhai hai, woh husain mera hai
<<DIVIDER>>
12. Jab mulukiyat ki naqaab tifl odh kar aaya
jisne barsare darbaar usko be naqaab kiya
<<DIVIDER>>
jiski khwahar aisi hai, wo husain mera hai
13. Sibt e jafar ek shayar, soz khane aale nabi
<<DIVIDER>>
usko izzat o shohrat panjetan ke darr se mili
jiska faiz jaari hai, wo husain mera hai
author: Sibte Jaffer Shaheed
